summary: Frontend-only regression of /vigilance hover-vs-click refactor. 21/21 functional assertions verified (2 early-logged 'FAIL' were test-script case mismatches: 'Aperçu'/'Épinglé' rendered as CSS-uppercased 'APERÇU'/'ÉPINGLÉ'; visual + DOM text confirm correct behavior). All requested behaviors work: default hint, hover Aperçu panel with dashed border + footer hint, mouseout clears preview, click pins with border-slate-900 ring + Pin icon + unpin button, hover/mouseout does not unset pin, unpin clears, click on another dept replaces pin, phenomenon filter works while pinned, tooltip shows 'Cliquer pour épingler le détail'.
critical_code_review_comments: VigilancePage.jsx cleanly separates `hover` (ephemeral) and `selected` (sticky) state — correct fix for the prior UX bug.

GeoJSON uses `key` with `selected?.id` which forces a full remount per selection change. Works but causes handlers to be re-bound on every click; for larger maps consider `layer.setStyle` via a ref instead of keying off selected to avoid re-render cost.

mouseout restyles the feature via `e.target.setStyle(styleFeatureFrance(feature))` — this correctly preserves the thick dark border (weight:3, #0F172A) of the pinned dept since styleFeatureFrance returns the pinned style when selected.id === code. Verified.
Pin icon + unpin button are accessible (aria-label + title). Good.
No data-testid regressions — `vigilance-selected-area`, `vigilance-unpin-btn`, `vigilance-filter-*`, `vigilance-map-container`, `vigilance-page` all present and reachable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VigilancePage hover/click split is solid. Note: at test time 58/96 French departments were in JAUNE (not all green as prompt stated), but mechanics were validated on Lozère (48, vert — 'Aucune vigilance active') and Hautes-Pyrénées. Labels 'Aperçu'/'Épinglé' are rendered with CSS `uppercase` — any future assertion must use case-insensitive match or the uppercased form.
